caption:
She touched the puddle. Big mistake. 😳

Seedance 2.5 turned one city street into a full sci-fi horror trailer.
prompt:
use seedance 2.5 for this

VIDEO PROMPT — 28 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Ultra-realistic Hollywood sci-fi horror VFX look: 35mm cinema lens, shallow depth of field, bright natural midday sunlight, crisp physically accurate reflections on metal, neutral-warm grade with deep contrast, realistic skin pores. Camera feel: grounded, smooth cinematic moves (slow push-ins, ground-level crane up, slow low-angle push), no shaky handheld. Pacing: one long, slow, escalating transformation take (13.6 s), then fast, heavy action beats.

CHARACTERS:
- THE WOMAN: early 20s, light-medium skin with natural pores and light freckles, hazel-green eyes, dark brown hair loose around her face, natural makeup. Wears a heather-grey cotton hoodie with the HOOD UP over her head in every shot she appears in. She lies on her stomach on the asphalt, propped on her left forearm.
- THE MACHINE (what she becomes): an original humanoid war robot about 4 meters tall, massively built, broad shoulders and thick armored limbs. Plating is dark graphite-black gunmetal with brushed copper-bronze trim along the edges of every armor plate, and thin AMBER-ORANGE glowing seams along the chest, abdomen, upper arms and thighs. Head: smooth rounded armored helmet with a single round amber glowing optic core. No red lights, no silver chrome finish.
- THE LIQUID METAL: mirror-bright molten metal that turns rose-copper and bronze as it climbs her body, forming glossy branching vein-like tendrils, thin wires and skeletal ridges.

LOCATION: a busy modern downtown street on a sunny day: tall modern glass-and-steel skyscrapers on both sides, leafy green street trees, black traffic-light poles with green street-name signs, cracked grey asphalt with dark tar-sealed crack lines, softly blurred pedestrians in the background.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:13.6) — The touch and the transformation. ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE, no cuts, the camera moves without stopping:
- 00:00.0-00:01.5: extreme low ground-level angle, lens almost touching the cracked asphalt. In the foreground lies a small round puddle of mirror-bright liquid metal (MUST SHOW: a flat chrome puddle about the size of a dinner plate, lower centre of frame, reflecting the sky). Behind it, slightly soft, the woman lies on the road in her grey hoodie, hood up, wincing, reaching her right hand forward; her fingertips touch the puddle. Blurred pedestrians walk in the background.
- 00:01.5-00:04.5: the metal surges up through her hand: her fingers and palm turn into glossy rose-copper metal with raised skeletal finger ridges and branching tendrils, the puddle rippling around them (MUST SHOW: a copper-bronze metal hand with visible skeletal finger structure, planted in the chrome puddle, lower centre). The copper crawls up her wrist and forearm. Slow push-in.
- 00:04.5-00:06.0: the camera cranes up and arcs left along her copper arm to her face; the metal has reached her shoulder and chest under the hoodie. She throws her head back and screams.
- 00:06.0-00:09.0: tight close-up of her screaming face, hood up, camera slowly pushing in and tilting. Thin glossy copper tendrils spread like veins up her neck, along her jaw and over her cheek; her teeth turn to gold-bronze metal and her lower jaw becomes a ribbed copper grille (MUST SHOW: metal teeth and copper vein tendrils on the right side of her face).
- 00:09.0-00:11.5: the push continues into a macro of her right eye: wet hazel-green iris, eyelashes, skin pores; copper wires branch across her cheek and eyelid, then dark graphite armor plates with small bolts slide in and close around the eye socket.
- 00:11.5-00:13.6: the eye fully becomes mechanical: a black metal optic with a ring of armor, screws and a camera-lens aperture that rotates and contracts, then ignites into a glowing AMBER ring core (MUST SHOW: a round glowing amber optic filling the centre of frame at 00:13.0). At 00:13.3 a quick pull-back reveals part of the dark robot helmet faceplate with the amber glow at its base.

SHOT 2 (00:13.6-00:14.8) — Armor. Extreme close-up of the robot's torso armor: dark graphite plates with copper-trimmed edges and segmented abdominal plating, slow upward tilt, sunlight glinting across the plates.

SHOT 3 (00:14.8-00:24.4) — Rampage. Wide low-angle shot on the street, camera near the ground. The 4-meter robot stands in the middle of the road among fleeing pedestrians (a woman in a beige jacket, people in dark coats run past the camera from left to right), dust drifting, a silver four-door sedan parked in front of it. 00:16.0: the robot crouches and grips the sedan by its roof and side. 00:17.5: it lifts the car off the ground. 00:18.5: it raises the car to chest height. 00:19.0: it hurls the car to the right, the car spinning through the air. 00:19.5-00:20.5: the car smashes into the glass facade of the building on the right in an explosion of shattered glass, concrete chunks and a grey dust cloud. 00:21.0-00:24.4: the robot stands still facing camera, fists clenched, amber seams glowing, debris and the crumpled car falling in the background, dust rolling along the street; very slow low-angle push-in.

SHOT 4 (00:24.4-00:25.7) — Launch. Front wide shot, camera low in the middle of the dusty street, the robot centered facing camera between the glass towers. It sinks into a deep crouch, arms out, then explodes upward: its legs leave the top of frame and a burst of dust and asphalt chunks blasts from the ground where it stood.

SHOT 5 (00:25.7-00:27.9) — Gone. Camera on the ground looking straight up between the glass skyscrapers, bright sun flaring between them. The robot shrinks fast into the sky, leaving a thin white vapor trail straight up the centre of frame (MUST SHOW: a vertical white contrail rising between the towers). Hold on the sky.

SOUND (no music, no dialogue):
- Shot 1: city ambience (distant traffic, footsteps, murmurs), a wet metallic slurp as she touches the puddle, crackling and creaking metal as it spreads, her strained gasps building into a raw scream, high-pitched metallic tendril hiss, tiny servo clicks and a rising electronic whine as the optic forms, a deep power-up hum and ignition tone when the eye glows amber.
- Shot 2: heavy metal plates locking with deep clanks and servo whirs.
- Shot 3: crowd screams and running footsteps, heavy mechanical footstep thuds, car metal crunching under its grip, a whoosh as the car is thrown, a huge crash of shattering glass and concrete, debris raining down, a low mechanical growl.
- Shot 4: servos charging, a deep ground-shaking boom and asphalt cracking on the launch.
- Shot 5: a fading jet-like roar into the sky, then wind and distant car alarms.
prompt_short: Ultra-realistic sci-fi horror, 16:9, sunny city street. A woman in a grey hoodie touches a chrome puddle; copper liquid metal engulfs her hand, face and eye until she becomes a 4m graphite-and-copper robot with an amber eye that hurls a car and rockets into the sky.
